For the Appellant : Mr. Shekhar Prasad Sinha, Advocate For the State : Ms. Priya Shrestha, P.P.
------
04/15.07.2024 I.A. No. 4555 of 2024 This interlocutory application has been filed by the appellant,
praying therein to suspend the sentence and release them on bail during pendency of this appeal.

2. The appellant has been convicted and sentenced in connection with in Spl. (POCSO) Case No. 152 of 2019, arising out of Chirkunda (Panchet O.P.) P.S. Case No.215 of 2020, for the offence under Section 376 of IPC and Section 6 of POCSO Act.
He has been sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for twenty years and fine amount of Rs.10,000/- for the offence under Section 6 of POCSO Act.

3. Heard, the learned counsel for the appellant and learned A.P.P. for the State and have gone through the impugned judgment, the evidence and the Trial Court Records.
4.
Learned counsel on behalf of appellant submits that the victim had married the appellant and living happily for ten years.
5. Opportunity was given to the State to oppose the bail, which the State availed and opposed.

6. A report was called for from Secretary, DLSA, Dhanbad, who has reported before this Court that he has conducted an enquiry himself whereby it has been informed that marriage has been solemnized as there was love affair since last ten years.
7.
Considering the aforesaid facts, we are inclined to allow this interlocutory application.
